segments.text: Ok so this is the headless threads page for OpenAI Agents, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the runtime calls the agent default, but the quickstart uses the OpenAI agent.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part, the agent and the session check, wasn't on the page, so I had to add it myself.
Moving on to the demo. The chat should reply and the sidebar should list the thread, but umm, it says agent not found, and nothing gets listed.
So basically, the two agent names never match, so the chat can't find its agent, and the page also leaves the agent and the session check undefined.
